items.headline: Weigman throws for 305 yards and leads No. 23 Houston to a 33-20 win over Oregon State
items.description: — Conner Weigman threw for 305 yards and a touchdown and rushed for another score, Re’Shaun Sanford II and Mekhi Hughes added rushing scores and No. 23 Houston beat Oregon State 33-20 on Saturday in the teams’ season opener.

items.headline: Sources: Oregon State names Braden Atkinson starting QB
items.description: Sources have told ESPN's Pete Thamel that Oregon State first-year coach JaMarcus Shephard on Monday named Braden Atkinson the team's starting quarterback, a transfer from Mercer who will be under center when the Beavers take on No. 23 Houston on Sept. 5.
